note: Rows in one card with hairlines only between them, from a pod's own layouts (decision element-roles-and-reuse)

component.doc: Rows in one rounded card with hairlines only between them (never after the last): a list, a menu, a settings group. Its child is usually one core://List with spacing_dp 1, or rows in a core://Column with spacing_dp 1; each row draws on the card colour (core:item_row does), and the 1 dp gaps show card_border as the separators. For rows that bring their own core://Divider use core:grouped_card. Its corners follow the theme's scale (corner_l, set_theme) unless corner is given.

params.name: corner
params.doc: Corner radius in dp; 0 for the theme's corner_l (18 unless the pod set it).
